statBlock.name: Clockwork Bronze Scout
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: A clockwork scout that burrows beneath its prey and releases lightning through the ground.

sections.Languages: Understands one language of its creator but can't speak.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned.
sections.Traits:
Earth Armor. Burrowing doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.
Magic Resistance. The clockwork has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Unusual Nature. The clockwork needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) lightning damage.
Lightning Flare (recharges after a short or long rest). Every creature touching the ground within 15 ft. of the scout makes a DC 13 Dexterity save, taking 14 (4d6) lightning damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 79.

statBlock.name: Clockwork Iron Cobra
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: A mechanical serpent with a bite that can bewilder, paralyze, or poison a creature.

sections.Languages: Understands one language of its creator but can't speak.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned.
sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The clockwork has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Unusual Nature. The clockwork needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. A creature hit must make a DC 13 Constitution save. On a failure, roll 1d6 for the effect below.
1–2, Confusion. On its next turn, the target must use its action to make one weapon attack against a random creature it can see within 30 ft. of itself. It uses the weapon it is holding and moves into attack range first if necessary. If it holds no weapon, it makes an unarmed strike. If it sees no creature within 30 ft., it takes the Dash action and moves toward the nearest creature.
3–4, Paralysis. The target is paralyzed until the end of its next turn.
5–6, Poison. The target takes 13 (3d8) poison damage.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 79.

statBlock.name: Clockwork Oaken Bolter
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: A clockwork siege engine armed with bolts and a tethered harpoon.

sections.Languages: Understands one language of its creator but can't speak.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned.
sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The clockwork has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Unusual Nature. The clockwork needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Lancing Bolt attacks, or make one Lancing Bolt attack and one Harpoon attack.
Lancing Bolt. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 100/400 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage.
Harpoon. Ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, range 50/200 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage and grapples the target (escape DC 12). The grapple leaves a creature's speed unchanged but limits its movement to directions that bring it closer to the bolter. A creature takes 5 (1d10) slashing damage if it escapes the grapple or fails an escape attempt. The bolter can grapple only one creature at a time with the harpoon.
Explosive Bolt (Recharge 5–6). Choose a point within 120 ft. Each creature in a 20-ft.-radius sphere centered there makes a DC 15 Dexterity save, taking 17 (5d6) fire damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Bonus actions: Reel In. Pull the creature grappled by Harpoon up to 20 ft. closer to the bolter.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 80.

statBlock.name: Clockwork Stone Defender
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: A stone-plated guard that knocks enemies down and shields creatures beside it.

sections.Languages: Understands one language of its creator but can't speak.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned.
sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The clockwork has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Unusual Nature. The clockwork needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions: Slam. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and knocks a Large or smaller target prone.
sections.Reactions: Intercept Attack. When an attack roll hits another creature within 5 ft. of the defender, the defender can give that creature +5 AC against the triggering attack, potentially turning the hit into a miss. The defender must see both the creature and the attacker.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 80.

statBlock.name: Cloud Giant Smiling One
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: A cloud giant trickster who changes shape, controls the weather, and strikes with telekinetic force.

sections.Traits: Control Weather (8th-level spell). The giant can cast Control Weather with Charisma and needs no material components.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks or two Telekinetic Strike attacks.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (3d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (1d10) psychic damage.
Telekinetic Strike. Ranged spell attack, +7 to hit, range 240 ft., one target. A hit deals 25 (4d10 + 3) force damage.
Change Shape. The giant magically takes on the appearance and feel of a Beast or Humanoid it has seen, or returns to its true form. The new form absorbs any equipment the giant wears or carries. Its size can change, and it keeps its other statistics. Death returns the giant to its true form.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 15). These spells require no material components.
At will. Detect Magic, Fog Cloud, Light, Minor Illusion.
3/day each. Invisibility, Silent Image, Suggestion, Tongues.
1/day each. Gaseous Form, Major Image.
sections.Bonus actions: Cloud Step (Recharge 4–6). Teleport up to 60 ft. to an unoccupied space the giant can see, taking all worn and carried equipment.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 81.

statBlock.name: Conjurer Wizard
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: A wizard who swaps places with willing allies and summons an elemental to fight alongside them.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Arcane Burst attacks.
Arcane Burst. Melee or ranged spell attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (3d10 + 3) force damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Intelligence (spell save DC 14).
At will. Dancing Lights, Mage Hand, Prestidigitation.
2/day each. Fireball, Mage Armor, Unseen Servant.
1/day each. Fly, Stinking Cloud, Web.
sections.Bonus actions:
Benign Transportation (Recharge 4–6). Teleport up to 30 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space, taking all worn and carried equipment. The conjurer can instead choose a space within range occupied by a willing Small or Medium creature. They both teleport and swap places.
Summon Elemental (1/day). Magically summon an Air Elemental, Earth Elemental, Fire Elemental, or Water Elemental in an unoccupied space within 60 ft. of the conjurer. The elemental obeys the conjurer and takes its turn immediately after theirs. It lasts up to 1 hour and disappears sooner if it dies, the conjurer dies, or the conjurer dismisses it as a bonus action.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 260.

statBlock.name: Corpse Flower
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: A climbing plant that gathers humanoid corpses to feed on or raise as zombies.

sections.Traits:
Corpses. When first encountered, the flower holds 1d6 + 3 Humanoid corpses, up to its capacity of nine. These corpses have total cover against attacks and other effects coming from outside the flower. If the flower dies, the corpses can be pulled free.
Spider Climb. The flower climbs difficult surfaces, including ceilings upside down, without making an ability check.
Stench of Death. A creature that starts its turn within 10 ft. of the flower or one of its zombies makes a DC 14 Constitution save. Constructs and Undead are exempt. On a failure, the creature is poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a success, it is immune to Stench of Death from all corpse flowers for 24 hours.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Tentacle attacks.
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.
Harvest the Dead. Swallow one unsecured Humanoid corpse within 10 ft. and everything it is wearing or carrying.
sections.Bonus actions:
Digest. Destroy one corpse stored in the flower and immediately regain 11 (2d10) hit points. The flower expels the corpse's equipment into its own space.
Reanimate. Raise one stored corpse as a Zombie in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the flower. The zombie acts immediately after the flower in initiative and is its ally. The flower can't control the zombie. It carries the flower's Stench of Death.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 82.
